messages.author: 1220f7a833c6ec8b
messages.subject: Chromosome-level significances
parts:
Hi!

In old RQTL, it was possible to run a permutation analysis just for one chromosome. Is that still possible in RQTL2?

operm <- scan1perm(pr$`1`, iron$pheno, n_perm=10) produces an error.

Alternatively, is this is a bad idea such that we should not try to do it?

Thanks!

Joanna
